## Purpose

Linear A decipherment project: corpus, decipherment, grammar, wine tablets.

## Routing

Fleet-Orchestrator coordinates. CorpusBot builds datasets; Decipherer and GrammarBot test hypotheses; WineResearchAgent covers wine tablets/jars and coordinates with CorpusBot/Decipherer. SearchCrew/CiteChecker libraries support citation work.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-fleet-orchestrator`.
